commit c8ce123142fa53f2cb55b6d8c3c249e9860c6f8a
Author: Nick Hung <nick@andestech.com>
Date:   Mon Jun 8 09:49:18 2026 +0800

    hw/riscv/andes_ae350: honor -object memory-backend-file for DRAM
    
    Adopt the modern machine->ram idiom used by virt.c and most other QEMU
    machines: set mc->default_ram_id and let the machine framework either
    auto-create an anonymous memory-backend (the existing behavior) or
    consume a user-supplied -object memory-backend-file,id=mem (the new
    capability). Replace the local memory_region_init_ram(main_mem, ...)
    + add_subregion(..., main_mem) pair with a single add_subregion that
    binds the DRAM range to machine->ram.
    
    Behavior is unchanged for users who do not pass -object memory-backend:
    the framework auto-creates an anonymous backend with the default_ram_id,
    identical to the prior init_ram call. Users who pass
    -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem now get DRAM backed by a shared
    file - required for the hybrid-sim QEMU<->vsim shared-RAM round-trip on
    this board.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 7457caebdf360178503e6b7536efaf70ae8c1351
Author: Nick Hung <nick@andestech.com>
Date:   Fri Jun 26 09:45:37 2026 +0800

    riscv/andes_ae350: add SimControl exit device at 0xe0080000
    
    The vplat runtime exits via writes to 0xe0080000 (SimControl), but this
    device was absent from the ae350 machine, causing all vplat ELFs to hang
    indefinitely under QEMU.
    
    Add an inline MemoryRegionOps handler (andesim_ctrl_ops) at that address.
    Write semantics match the vsim SimControl device: value < 256 is a raw exit
    code; the magic values 0x01234567/68/71 exit 0 (pass/finish/skip) and
    0x01234569/70 exit 1 (fail/warn).
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 86d433001e62858bc262592fc600ca7a99ea9815
Author: Nick Hung <nick@andestech.com>
Date:   Mon Jul 6 17:41:52 2026 +0800

    hw/riscv/andes_ae350: seed L2C Control Register reset value (CEN=1)
    
    The L2C block at 0xE0500000 is modelled as a plain RAM stub, which
    zero-initialises, but DS220 11.8.7 resets the Control Register (offset
    0x0008) to CEN=1 -- L2 enabled by default. Seed that value at machine
    init so a guest that relies on the hardware default (never writing
    0x0008) reads back the true reset state.
    
    This matters for the andesim hybrid handoff: the TCG plugin drains the
    L2C register window by physical address at the QEMU->vsim boundary, and
    without the seed an untouched register drains CEN=0, which would restore
    L2-disabled into an L2C-capable cycle engine and inflate the measured
    cycle figure severalfold. Verified by andesim's
    tests/plugin/test_plugin_l2c_reset_default.sh.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

 hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c | 11 +++++++++++
 1 file changed, 11 insertions(+)

+++ b/hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c
@@ -1494,6 +1494,17 @@ static void andes_ae350_machine_init(MachineState *machine)
     memory_region_set_readonly(mask_l2c, false);
     memory_region_add_subregion(system_memory, memmap[ANDES_AE350_L2C].base,
                                 mask_l2c);
+    /*
+     * The L2C register block is modelled as a plain RAM stub, which zero-
+     * initialises. DS220 11.8.7 gives the L2C Control Register (offset 0x0008)
+     * a reset value of CEN=1 (L2 enabled by default), so seed that here. Without
+     * it a guest that relies on the reset default -- never writing 0x0008, as the
+     * andesim vplat runtime does -- would read CEN=0, and the hybrid handoff
+     * would drain CEN=0 and wrongly disable L2 in the cycle-accurate engine.
+     * All documented control bits live in the low 32, so a 32-bit LE store
+     * suffices. Applied once at machine init; the hybrid flow boots once.
+     */
+    stl_le_p((uint8_t *)memory_region_get_ram_ptr(mask_l2c) + 0x0008, 0x1);

commits.subject: hw/riscv/andes_ae350: honor -object memory-backend-file for DRAM
commits.notes: Adopts the machine->ram / mc->default_ram_id idiom so ae350 DRAM (plus the DRAM_EXT window, via aliases into one backend) can be backed by a user-supplied memory-backend-file; this is the QEMU-side enabler of the /dev/shm shared-RAM handoff. Clean, self-contained, message is accurate and explains behavior-preservation for non-backend users; no changes needed.

commits.subject: riscv/andes_ae350: add SimControl exit device at 0xe0080000
commits.notes: Adds an inline MemoryRegionOps write handler at 0xe0080000 matching vsim's SimControl exit semantics so vplat-linked ELFs terminate QEMU instead of hanging; QEMU-side counterpart of the vplat runtime's exit path. Clean and reviewable as-is. Minor note: andesim's CLAUDE.md refers to this as hw/misc/andes_sim_control.c, but in this repo it lives inline in andes_ae350.c (doc drift, not a commit defect).

commits.subject: hw/riscv/andes_ae350: seed L2C Control Register reset value (CEN=1)
commits.notes: Seeds CEN=1 at offset 0x0008 of the RAM-stub L2C block at machine init per DS220 11.8.7, so a guest that never writes the register drains the true reset value across the hybrid handoff (otherwise the v5 L2C transport would restore L2-disabled into an L2C engine). QEMU-side half of the l2c-v5 feature; self-contained, message cites the spec and the covering test (tests/plugin/test_plugin_l2c_reset_default.sh); no changes needed.
